name: YMD Date
description: A field for storing pre-1970 dates with optional month and day elements.
project_description:
This module provides a date field which allows dates prior to the Unix epoch (1970) and allows values of year only, year/month, or year/month/day. The date value is stored in the format YYYYMMDD which allows natural sorting. When no month or day selection is made, 00 is stored in its place.

A formatter is included which displays the date using the standard Drupal date/time formats of your choice, choosing a different format depending on whether the stored value has month and day precision.

The included field widget presents year/month/day select lists; the beginning year of the year selector is a per-field setting and the range runs from that year to the current year.

A Views filter (extending the numeric filter) with year/month/day select inputs, a year-only Token, and a Feeds target are also included.
